extracted.intended_audience: foundation staff, community foundation leaders, and philanthropic professionals

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Pathways
rubrics_metrics.description: A leadership program that accelerates the careers of diverse professionals in the philanthropy sector. Graduates of the program will deepen their expertise, expand their networks, and hone their leadership skills to advance the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program goal-focused: accelerate careers of diverse philanthropy professionals by deepening expertise, expanding networks, and honing leadership skills. (Page provides a brief program summary; details and selection criteria are available on the program page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Council Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council's award programs were established to recognize excellence in philanthropy and honor exemplary leaders for their dedication in uplifting the sector.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: recognize excellence and exemplary leadership in philanthropy. Implies criteria emphasize demonstrated excellence and service to the sector; detailed award categories, nomination, and selection criteria are on the award-specific pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global Philanthropy
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council is actively working to build connections among U.S. and global foundations that are addressing problems and advancing change around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic aim: facilitate cross-border connections among foundations focused on problem-solving and systems change. Evaluation likely centers on partnership-building, international engagement, and impact orientation (further specifics on the global program page).

rubrics_metrics.name: National Standards for U.S. Community Foundations™
rubrics_metrics.description: Developed in the spirit of accountability, transparency, and continuous self-improvement, National Standards for U.S. Community Foundation are philanthropy's most rigorous standards—evidence that community foundations seek excellence for their communities and donors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards-oriented criterion: emphasizes accountability, transparency, continuous self-improvement, and rigorous evidence of excellence to communities and donors. This entry denotes an explicit set of standards (the page is a summary; the full standards contain the specific measurable requirements and compliance guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Council Services & Initiatives / Foundation-Specific Programs & Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Service to foundations is in our DNA. While we may have started with community foundations, we've grown throughout our history to serve foundations and institutional givers of all kinds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catch-all service offering: tailored programs and services for a variety of foundation types. Implies flexible, foundation-specific assistance; concrete offerings and eligibility details are on linked program pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Council Initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Council initiatives are short-term or timebound activities that help advance our mission, vision, and strategic direction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initiative design criterion: timebound/short-term activities with a clear linkage to advancing the Council's mission and strategic goals. Selection or participation criteria are likely program-specific and described on initiative pages.
